designPrinciple.reason: Candidate v0.4 exposes three separable promoted-gate failure surfaces that cannot be repaired by one threshold: eligible-but-route-insufficient safety leakage before both Arbitration and Fallback; Fallback Identity recall/precision family confusion; and no-arbitration Selection allowing Router/Compatibility to override or bypass Fallback identity admission. Routeability recall is real but remains deferred so the next fresh development can attribute these three changes before spending another model revision.

explicitlyDeferred: Semantic Act Eligibility retraining or threshold retuning
